name: tabs
description: UIDS tabs component contract, preserving the verified 4.x rendering and documenting the proposed Figma representation.

figma.note: BUILT (Phase 3). State (Selected, Unselected) is the only true axis, diverging from the survey's proposed 2x3 = 6 (State x Background-context). Background context (default / on-black / on-gold) is context frames on the Components/Tabs page, not a multiplying axis.
axisRationale: Tabs' bg-- response is a passive ancestor read, structurally identical to Button's and Headline's — not a component-owned composition choice the way Brand Bar's Style axis is a designer-pickable composition. So it follows Headline's 'on-gold flips are context frames, not axes' and Button's ancestor-bg-in-behavior-only pattern.
Hover and focus-visible are excluded as a static axis for the same reason as Button (Color x Size x Style, no hover axis) — represent them as Figma interactive/prototype states instead.

If Context is later made a real axis (a legitimate reading, see openQuestions), note that two of the six State x Context cells (Selected/Default, Selected/On-Gold) have NO tabs-owned text-colour token at all: their text layer would need to bind background.json's color/on-light/text directly — a cross-contract binding precedented by Brand Bar's nested Logo instance.
figma.precedent: Headline / Button (ancestor background is context, not an axis).

options.name: items
options.description: Keys per item: title, content. One entry per tab; the array's ORDER is the tab order, and the first entry is the initially selected tab. Required, with no default: the component renders nothing without it. Added 2026-08-20 to close the long-standing check-contracts warning that this Vue prop was unclaimed by any contract option — the schema already supported array/object option types.

code.notes: Vue marks it required:true with type:Array and no default.

figma.notes: Content, not a variant axis: the number of entries drives how many rows/tabs/crumbs are drawn, which Figma expresses by duplicating the child instance rather than by a variant property.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Not a shipped option. Tabs.vue currently renders horizontal semantics only; tabs.js can interpret aria-orientation=vertical, but no producer sets it.

code.notes: Tabs.vue now exists but exposes no orientation prop. Adding one would be a future API change.

figma.notes: No visual difference exists in tabs.scss between orientations — it's a pure keyboard-navigation concern, not a variant-axis candidate under either identity.kind resolution.

options.name: id
options.description: Required root ID used to derive tab/panel IDs and scope hash activation.

slots.name: items
slots.description: A required Array prop rather than a Vue slot. Each item provides title and HTML content.
slots.behavior: Tabs.vue renders each title into a tab button and each content value via v-html into its corresponding tabpanel.

figma.notes: Model labels as editable text and panel bodies as placeholder content frames.

behavior: Tabs.vue imports tabs.scss and the production tabs.js behavior, then explicitly instantiates window.UidsTabs after mount because the script's initial document scan runs before the component exists.
State is driven by aria-selected, hidden, and roving tabindex. First tab/panel is selected/visible initially; click, arrow, Home/End, hash, and popstate behavior comes from tabs.js.
Ancestor bg--black/bg--gold contexts repaint tab text and indicators. These are documentation frames, not a component prop or Figma axis.
Persistent ::after state indicators and transient ::before hover/focus indicators share the height token but have independent colors and cascade rules.
Vertical keyboard handling exists in tabs.js but remains unreachable because Tabs.vue and production Twig set no aria-orientation.
knownIssues: Dead import: @use '../abstracts/utilities'; (tabs.scss:2) — the utilities namespace is never referenced anywhere in the file. See claims.

`.is-hidden` (tabs.scss:120, display:none) is dead CSS — no producer in this repo or uids_base ever applies the class; both tabs.js and every Twig template that renders role=tabpanel markup use the native `hidden` attribute exclusively. Likely leftover from an earlier JS implementation. See claims.

tabs.scss:45-47's unconditional `[class*="bg--black"] & { color: $light; }` is specificity-dead — never the winning declaration for any shipped [role=tab], because every real tab always also matches the more specific aria-selected=true or =false sibling rule. The genuine provenance for the 'unselected + on-black' token value is tabs.scss:83-85, not this line. See claims.

The gold focus-visible indicator declared at tabs.scss:53-55 never renders when the tab's ancestor is bg--gold, due to a specificity tie with the later-declared bg--gold hover/focus rule (tabs.scss:103-105) — see claims. Codified as-shipped: the rendered behavior under bg--gold is med-gray, not gold.

tabs.scss:31's `transition: background 0.8s ease-out;` on the bare [role="tab"] is inert — no rule in the file ever changes that element's own background away from its base `none`; every other background change targets the ::before/::after pseudo-elements, which don't inherit this transition and each declare their own. See claims.

Selected tabs have no explicit ambient (non-bg--black) text-color rule — only unselected tabs do (tabs.scss:72). A selected tab's default-context text falls through to whatever inherits from its container (in practice, the background foundation's on-light/on-dark cascade — see behavior and openQuestions).
aria-orientation="vertical" is read by tabs.js (tabs.js:248) but set by no shipped producer in either repo — the vertical arrow-key branch is unreachable in current production markup. See claims.
Asymmetric tab padding (1rem / 1.3rem / 1rem, tabs.scss:24) — codified as-shipped, not rounded to match, mirroring Button's own asymmetric block-end precedent.
The draft spec predated Tabs.vue and described Tabs as a local build orphan. That is no longer true after aa71cff490; tabs.js vendoring drift downstream remains separately documented.

geometryNotTokenized.clearfix: .tabs-collection::before/::after { display: table; content: ' '; } (tabs.scss:9-13) — classic float-clearfix hack, not a design value.
geometryNotTokenized.tablist-overlap-margin: -0.1rem margin-bottom on [role=tablist] (tabs.scss:16, third value of `margin: 0 0 -0.1rem;`) — a hairline visual-overlap offset. tokens/README's tier-3 convention states plainly that 'one-off paddings and offsets stay as raw geometry, documented in the component's contract' — treated as such here, NOT minted as a token. (A defensible alternative reading tokenizes it instead, citing Button's do-not-fix-asymmetric-padding precedent the other direction; flagged in openQuestions rather than silently decided.)
geometryNotTokenized.tablist-font-size-zero: font-size: 0 on [role=tablist] (tabs.scss:18) — the standard inline-block whitespace-gap suppression trick between adjacent tab buttons; a rendering mechanic, not a design value (same category as Headline's box-decoration-break).
geometryNotTokenized.tab-resets: border: none; overflow: visible; background: none; cursor: pointer; on [role=tab] (tabs.scss:21-32) — structural resets; unlike Button, Tabs declares no border at all.
geometryNotTokenized.indicator-motion: transition: background 0.8s ease-out (tabs.scss:31 — also inert, see claims) and transition: 0.3s (tabs.scss:41,95, shared by ::before/::after) — duration/easing left un-tokenized following Button's focus-bar-motion precedent ('Only its color and height are tokenized'); only the animated properties' color/height get tier-3 leaves here too.
geometryNotTokenized.indicator-positioning: position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 0 (state-driven) on both ::before/::after, plus ::before's z-index: 1 (tabs.scss:34-43,88-96) — stacking/layout plumbing for the sliding-bar effect; only height and color are tokenized.
geometryNotTokenized.tabpanel-mechanics: [role=tabpanel] { position: relative; z-index: 2; } plus a flat, non-meaningful 0 inline padding (tabs.scss:115-119) — only padding-block is tokenized (tabs/panel/padding-block); position/z-index is stacking-context plumbing.
geometryNotTokenized.panel-child-spacing: [role=tabpanel] * + p { margin-top: 1rem; } (tabs.scss:125-127) — one-off adjacent-sibling paragraph spacing inside panel content, not identity-bearing to the tab/indicator shape.
geometryNotTokenized.structural-resets: border-radius: 0; outline: 0; on selected tabs, and outline: 0 on :active/:focus/:hover (tabs.scss:50-51,108-112) — zero-value resets relying on the custom ::before/::after indicators instead of the native focus ring.
